# Bulk Mail JavaScript API

Everything the [Bulk Mail](/docs/extensions/bulkmail) extension adds to `pb_hooks` and page code, generated from the TypeScript declarations it ships (your app's `types.d.ts` has the same, so your editor knows them). For how to use it, see its docs; for Go, the [Go API](/docs/reference/go).

## $bulkmail

Bulk mail campaigns. To react to its activity, use record hooks on its collections, e.g.
`onRecordAfterCreateSuccess(e => ..., "_bulkmail_suppressions")`.

### $bulkmail.start()

```ts
$bulkmail.start(id: string, limit?: number): core.Record
```

Starts a campaign (at most limit sends; 0 = all); returns the campaign record.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` |  |
| `limit` | `number` (optional) |  |

Returns `core.Record`.

### $bulkmail.pause()

```ts
$bulkmail.pause(id: string): core.Record
```

Stops sending (or a scheduled start) until resume; returns the campaign record.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` |  |

Returns `core.Record`.

### $bulkmail.resume()

```ts
$bulkmail.resume(id: string): core.Record
```

Continues a paused campaign; returns the campaign record.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` |  |

Returns `core.Record`.

### $bulkmail.cancel()

```ts
$bulkmail.cancel(id: string): core.Record
```

Stops a campaign for good: recipients still queued are marked skipped. Returns the campaign record.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` |  |

Returns `core.Record`.

### $bulkmail.test()

```ts
$bulkmail.test(id: string, to?: string): void
```

Sends one test message (to the given address, or the sender).

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` |  |
| `to` | `string` (optional) |  |

### $bulkmail.preview()

```ts
$bulkmail.preview(id: string, email?: string): bulkmail.Preview
```

Renders the campaign for one recipient.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` |  |
| `email` | `string` (optional) |  |

Returns `bulkmail.Preview`.

### $bulkmail.count()

```ts
$bulkmail.count(audience: bulkmail.Audience): { count: number; suppressed: number; sample: string[] }
```

Counts an audience: total, how many are suppressed, and a few sample addresses.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `audience` | `bulkmail.Audience` |  |

Returns `{ count: number; suppressed: number; sample: string[] }`.

### $bulkmail.suppress()

```ts
$bulkmail.suppress(email: string, reason?: string): core.Record
```

Adds the address to the suppression list (or updates its reason), so campaigns skip it. Fires no hooks: unsubscribe does.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `email` | `string` |  |
| `reason` | `string` (optional) |  |

Returns `core.Record`.

### $bulkmail.unsuppress()

```ts
$bulkmail.unsuppress(email: string): void
```

Takes the address off the suppression list, so campaigns reach it again.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `email` | `string` |  |

### $bulkmail.isSuppressed()

```ts
$bulkmail.isSuppressed(email: string): boolean
```

Whether campaigns skip the address (it's on the suppression list).

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `email` | `string` |  |

Returns `boolean`.

### $bulkmail.unsubscribe()

```ts
$bulkmail.unsubscribe(email: string, campaignId?: string): void
```

Suppresses the address and fires the unsubscribe hooks.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `email` | `string` |  |
| `campaignId` | `string` (optional) |  |

### $bulkmail.unsubscribeURL()

```ts
$bulkmail.unsubscribeURL(email: string, campaignId?: string): string
```

The address's unsubscribe link, as every campaign message and its List-Unsubscribe header carry it.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `email` | `string` |  |
| `campaignId` | `string` (optional) |  |

Returns `string`.

### $bulkmail.limits()

```ts
$bulkmail.limits(): { rate: number; daily: number; sentToday: number }
```

Sending limits: messages per second, per day, and sent today.

Returns `{ rate: number; daily: number; sentToday: number }`.

## Types

### bulkmail.Audience

Who a campaign goes to: records of a collection, or a read-only SQL query.

```ts
type bulkmail.Audience = { collection: string; filter?: string; email_field?: string } | { sql: string };
```

|---|---|---|

| `text` | `string` |  |
